name: MessageBroker
summary: Puts the routing of a whole system in one hub, so that each application has one channel rather than one per correspondent.

roles.name: MessageBroker
roles.summary: The hub every application sends to and receives from, and the only participant that knows the topology. It replaces the arithmetic of point-to-point integrations with a single dependency, and becomes the thing whose failure stops everything — which is the trade to state rather than discover.
